messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "taken about half an hour after the same meal each day"
set: ["taken about half an hour after the same meal each day", "take about 30 minutes after the same meal each day", "taken at approximately the same time each day", "use an injection on the same day each week", "extended-release capsules are taken once daily at about the same time each day", "take same way each day", "take at around the same time each day", "can be taken any time of the day but take at the same time each day", "take at same time each day", "about 1 hour", "take with food at the same time each day", "same day", "within about 1 hour", "take liquid medicine on an empty stomach at least 1 hour before a meal or 2 hours after a meal", "should be taken with food, with the evening meal", "most mouth-related effects resolve within an hour"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "take about 30 minutes after the same meal each day",
    "taken at approximately the same time each day",
    "take at around the same time each day",
    "take at same time each day",
    "take with food at the same time each day",
    "can be taken any time of the day but take at the same time each day"
  ],
  "alias": "taken about half an hour after the same meal each day"
}
